item.title: Karen turns passion into profession with new cookery business
item.description: After more than 27-years working in aviation, Karen Dodds from Fintona has successfully retrained in cookery at the age of 46 and launched her own food-based business Meadowclere Cookery School following a return to education at South West College

item.title: Rare Royal Mint coin sells for 500 times face value because of the Queen's head
item.description: The item is mis-struck, meaning it was incorrectly imprinted while being minted, and so the image of Queen Elizabeth II's head appears upside down.

item.title: Council tributes following death of 'dedicated' former councillor Bert Johnston
item.description: A minute silence has been held for the late Bert Johnston in the chamber of Fermanagh and Omagh Council after members fondly recalled him as dedicated, devoted and with a wonderful sense of humour.

item.title: Full life remembered for much-loved Vera during funeral service
item.description: A well-known Enniskillen woman remembered for her determination, warmth and sharp wit has been laid to rest following her passing at the age of almost 96.

item.title: Man to appear in court following robbery at entertainment venue

item.title: Care worker convicted of ill-treating vulnerable resident flees the country

item.title: 'I was woken by a blast': Families caught up as global tensions rise
